usage: Read-only local consultation of public generic downloads. No raw dictionary dump, definitions or paradigms imported into the game. Original 1,143-word inventory predates these checks. Glosses are original editorial descriptions; retained source notes describe factual observations and scope.
access_incident: Automatic approval review rejected external per-word requests because they disclose private-repository candidate words. All such tasks were stopped. Subsequent new retrievals used fixed generic public dataset URLs without private words or IDs; matching and reading happened locally. Completed earlier responses were retained with their actual retrieval timestamps.
limitations: No independent reference was found for ZÁŠEVEK; its individual record explicitly retains an AI editorial judgment and source limitation.
Public source morphology can contain errors: VĚŠÁK/ZÁPISNÍK/MEZERA discrepancies were individually resolved and noted.
No MorfFlex data used. No source visit is claimed for failed retrievals or links inspected only through local snapshots.
